title: Reported armed-civilian threats and attacks on families at the Rosarino settlement
reason: The report describes threats and attacks against settlement families, not a public mass gathering or protest event.
notes: CIVICUS frames the attack narrative as January 2021 but also says one shooting occurred on 9 January 2020. Date conflict unresolved. No protest turnout or organized public assembly is reported; do not infer one from broader land-rights mobilizations in 2019–2020.
